feed.title: Augmented Intelligence
feed.subtitle: Augmented Intelligence publishes concise, rigorous work on human+AI collaboration: applied studies, methods, verdicts and case reports where artificial intelligence augments professional judgment, with an emphasis on medicine, clinical operations and research workflows.

entry.title: The simulator owns truth, the model only narrates: an event-sourced architecture that keeps large language models out of canonical patient state in clinical simulation
entry.summary: An event-sourced architecture where the simulator owns canonical patient truth and the language model only narrates — keeping LLM hallucination out of clinical state, with the determinism invariant stated as an executable test others can adopt.
